title: Art of the Game: Celebrating creativity, culture and community across the globe

From Nigeria to the UK, Cape Town to Johannesburg, creativity took centre stage as artists and colleagues came together for our global Art of the Game competition.


Launched as part of Super Group Cares, the competition invited artists from around the world to transform basketballs into unique works of art, inspired by their culture, identity and creative vision. Bringing together sport, art and community, the initiative celebrated creative expression while making a meaningful difference to causes close to our artists’ hearts.


**And the winners are…**


Taking **first place** in the global competition was **Omomurewa Alade** from Nigeria, whose winning design impressed judges with its originality, creativity and celebration of cultural identity. Omomurewa received a **£10,000 cash prize** , alongside a further **£10,000 donation to her chosen charity, Feed the Widows Project** , a Lagos-based organisation supporting widows and vulnerable members of the community.


**Emily Green** from the UK claimed **second place, receiving £5,000, with an additional £5,000 donated to her chosen cancer research charity** .


The competition also gave Super Group colleagues an opportunity to showcase their artistic talents, with Lee-Ann Vermeulen from Cape Town taking first place and Prince Zwane from Johannesburg securing second place in the internal competition.


**Creativity with a purpose**


More than a celebration of artistic talent, Art of the Game demonstrated how creativity can bring people together and inspire positive change.


**Kirsty Ross, Chief Operating Officer at Super Group** , said: *“Art of the Game was created to celebrate the powerful connection between sport, creativity and community. Omomurewa Alade’s design captured that spirit brilliantly, and we’re delighted that her success will also make a meaningful difference through Feed the Widows Project. Through Super Group Cares, we remain committed to supporting initiatives that create lasting impact in the communities where we operate.”*


With £15,000 donated to charity through our global winners, Art of the Game has helped turn artistic achievement into meaningful support for communities. And the creativity lives on. **The winning designs have been transformed into basketballs, now displayed across Super Group offices worldwide** , creating a lasting reminder of the cultures, stories and communities that brought the competition to life.


Art of the Game is another example of how Super Group continues to go *All in* for our communities, connecting people through shared passions and creating impact that extends far beyond the canvas. Congratulations to all our winners, and thank you to everyone who brought their creativity and stories to Art of the Game.
